title: Spatial Transformer Network
core_mech: 定位网络预测变换参数，grid generator 与可微 sampler 将任务梯度传回几何坐标。
core_mech_en: Predicts geometric transformation parameters θ via a localization network, generates a transformed sampling grid, and warps feature maps via a differentiable sampler.
input_en: Input image or feature map U
output_desc: 按学习变换重采样后的 V
output_en: Spatially warped feature map V resampled over learned coordinates T_θ(G)

source.title: Spatial Transformer Network
notes: Maintained PyTorch teaching implementation of affine grid generation and bilinear sampling. Not the original paper's complete experiment suite.

adapter.name: Spatial Transformer Network
adapter.mechanism: Identity-initialized localization network predicts affine parameters for differentiable grid generation and resampling.
limitations: Synthetic 2D alignment rather than classification; affine grid coordinates are normalized, not patient millimetres.
Synthetic teaching data only; no clinical validity or published benchmark is claimed.
